kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اسلنقيت (form IIIq)
# اِسْلَنْقَيْتُ (islanqaytu) /is.lan.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
# اِسْلَنْقَيْتَ (islanqayta) /is.lan.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
# اِسْلَنْقَيْتِ (islanqayti) /is.lan.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْلَنْقَى (islanqā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
